extDescription.message: Automatically accepts ALL cookies on cookie consent banners, so every website works 100 %.

reason_userDecided.message: you made a choice in the banner

popup_setupNeeded.message: The extension is not active yet. Please confirm what it does first.

popup_siteActive.message: Accept cookies automatically on this site

popup_withdrawTitle.message: Deletes this site's cookies and storage, pauses the extension here and reloads – the banner appears again.

popup_searchReports.message: Search existing reports for this site

popup_reportHint.message: Continue opens a pre-filled issue on GitHub; nothing is sent before you submit it there. It contains the page address without parameters, the cookie banner’s text and buttons, the detected consent platforms and the extension’s log.

onboarding_what1.message: On every website you visit, I Love Cookies finds the cookie consent banner and answers it with the maximum consent offered ("Accept all") – on your behalf, automatically.

onboarding_what2.message: This means you agree, for every site, to:

onboarding_item1.message: all cookies and similar technologies (local storage, device identifiers),

onboarding_item3.message: data sharing with all listed partners/vendors – often hundreds per site.

onboarding_what3.message: In return, websites work completely: videos, maps, embedded content, comments and logins are no longer blocked, and you never see a cookie banner again.

onboarding_what4.message: You can pause the extension per site, and withdraw your consent for a site at any time from the toolbar popup ("Withdraw consent" deletes that site's cookies and shows the banner again).

onboarding_pay.message: Some sites let you choose between accepting tracking and a paid subscription. I Love Cookies always chooses the free option ("accept and continue with ads"). It never selects a paid option, never subscribes and never logs in for you.

onboarding_accept.message: I understand – accept all cookies for me

onboarding_done.message: ✓ Active. You can close this tab.

onboarding_privacy.message: I Love Cookies collects no data. Problem reports are only sent if you open and submit a GitHub issue yourself.

options_setupNeeded.message: The extension is not active yet.

options_debug.message: Debug logging in the page console

options_pausedEmpty.message: No paused sites. Pause a site from the toolbar popup.

options_remoteRules.message: Download rule updates daily (rules only – never program code)

options_aboutText.message: Version $1. Rules: DuckDuckGo autoconsent (MPL-2.0), Mozilla cookie banner rules (MPL-2.0), Consent-O-Matic (MIT) and I Love Cookies rules.
